pictures.observations: Whole500x667 high front oblique ordinary photo inspected while550 source build ran. Round weathered brick/stucco rotunda attached to taller church facade, concentric shallow tiled roof rings and small arched lantern with gray metal dome. Recessed pale rectangular portal/dark bronze doors, curved surviving low facade/arched niches, two pale standing right-hand columns and broken left-hand column bases, narrow frontal stair. Host church is taller and separate; rotunda visibility/attachment needs actual PMTiles fit.

pictures.author: Joris
pictures.observations: Whole500x667 entrance detail inspected. Closed patinated green bronze paired leaves with four recessed panels, studs and small ring fitting; pale deeply molded rectangular frame/entablature, smooth purple porphyry-like columns with pale leafy capitals and bases, narrow brick front stair. Ordinary original simplified ornament; no inscription or source-photo pixels copied.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific standing Romulus exterior: round weathered brick/lime body, concentric shallow tiled roof rings, eight-sided arched-window lantern and gray metal dome; projecting pale portal with purple shafts/leafy capitals and static closed green bronze paired leaves/panels/studs. Concave lower entrance wings with recessed arched niches, two standing right-hand columns and broken left bases. Neighboring church and independent halls remain native. No hidden ritual interior, copied sculpture/text atlas or complete restoration of missing front colonnades.
